def transform(grid):
    # Keep the pattern below the horizontal divider, recoloring its background
    # to the upper field color and its marked cells to the divider color.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0)
    bg = grid[0][0]
    mark = grid[divider][0]
    return [[bg if v == 0 else mark for v in row] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]

def transform(grid):
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and i > 0)
    background = grid[0][0]
    upper_marks = [v for row in grid[:divider] for v in row if v != background]
    marked_color = (upper_marks[0] + 1) % 10
    lower = grid[divider + 1:]
    lower_bg = min(set(v for row in lower for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in lower))
    return [[background if v == lower_bg else marked_color for v in row] for row in lower]
